6.376 rsInvalidBandInvalidLayoutDirection
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidBandInvalidLayoutDirection is a critical error that will occur when a Tablix element has
BandLayoutOptions specified and Tablix.LayoutDirection is not set to "LTR".
